headline: Committee discusses 2026 South Maui Community Plan, votes on stormwater and flood actions

meeting.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meeting.summary: The committee took up Section 3 of the plan after a Planning Department presentation and public testimony. Members voted to add a stormwater runoff action, rewrite a flood oversight action and pursue funding for nature-based flood projects.
meeting.recap: The only agenda item was the 2026 South Maui Community Plan.[[0:06:35]] The Planning Department gave a presentation and a quiz game on the plan's updated land use designations.[[0:10:36]] A community group's president asked the county not to designate Wailea Golf land for redevelopment until the applicant shows it can be served safely.[[0:43:02]] A testifier said some people were stuck for hours trying to leave Wailea during the 2025 tsunami.[[1:21:58]] The committee began work on Section 3 of the plan.[[1:46:18]] The plan splits South Maui into six sub-areas.[[1:55:40]] A county lawyer urged caution about redesignating land the county doesn't own for a possible wastewater plant.[[2:55:54]] Members voted to add an action to develop a plan to manage stormwater runoff from county facilities in South Maui.[[3:23:06]] Members voted to rewrite a flood action to improve oversight of repairs in flood hazard areas.[[3:38:31]] Members voted to have the county pursue funding for flood projects that favor nature-based solutions.[[3:44:33]]
meeting.next: The chair asked staff to check with the state about designating a planned veterans home parcel as public/quasi-public.

moments.q: "Okay, now it's time for a test. I mean a game."
"During the 2025 tsunami, some of us were stuck for hours trying to leave Wailea."
"That proposal was adopted as a bundle with all the other ones without even discussing it."

boards.name: Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

issues.oneLine: The plan's sub-area tables list total, occupied and vacant housing units for each area.
issues.why: A council member said the word "vacant" is not very accurate for these units.
issues.next: The chair suggested a footnote explaining where the vacant housing count comes from.
issues.brief: In sub-area one, 462 of 604 housing units are listed as vacant.[[#1]] Planning staff said public/quasi-public land can include affordable housing built by the government.[[#2]]
